written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Robin has hidden goodwill points starting at 0: insults subtract 1, apologies add 1, gifts change nothing; Robin is warm when goodwill is at least 1.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Robin has hidden patience starting at 1: insults always subtract 1, while apologies and gifts add 1 only if patience is still positive; Robin is warm when patience is positive.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Robin tracks a hidden grudge count: insults add 1; an apology clears a grudge of at most 1, otherwise just reduces it by 1; gifts do nothing; Robin is warm exactly when the grudge is 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Robin's mood is warm initially; insults make it cold; an apology makes it warm unless the two actions just before it were both insults; a gift makes it warm only when the previous action was also a gift.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge: insults add one; apologies clear a grudge of at most one, otherwise reduce it by one; gifts reduce a grudge only when it is at least two; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge: insults add one; apologies clear at most one or reduce by one; gifts turn any grudge of two or more into exactly one; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge: insults add one; gifts do nothing; apologies clear grudges of at most one, reduce a grudge of exactly two to one, and completely clear any grudge of three or more; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge and remembers whether a gift has occurred since the last insult; insults add one and cancel that memory; a gift sets the memory; an apology fully clears the grudge if the memory is set, otherwise it clears at most one or reduces by one; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge: insults add one; apologies clear at most one or reduce by one; gifts reduce a grudge of two or more by one, but a gift when the grudge is already 3+ resets it to zero; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge: insults add one; gifts reduce a grudge of two or more by one; apologies clear at most one or reduce by one, but an apology when the grudge is already 3+ clears it completely; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge: apologies clear at most one or reduce by one; gifts reduce a grudge of two or more by one; insults add one, but an insult when the grudge is already 3+ resets it to zero; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Robin keeps a grudge: insults add one; apologies clear at most one or reduce by one; gifts reduce a grudge of two or more by one; Robin is warm when the grudge is zero or at least four.

shown the survivors.comment: Robin's grudge rises with insults, apologies clear up to one or reduce by one, gifts reduce only a grudge of at least two, and Robin is warm only at grudge zero.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin starts cold with grudge 0; insults add 1 and make cold, gifts subtract 1, apologies clear grudge and warm if it is <=1, otherwise subtract 1 and stay cold.
